description: Produce a standard-library Python module that converts a quantity between named units of length, mass and temperature, plus pytest tests. Choose this when you need to convert a quantity between named units of length, mass or temperature and want the factors exact and the result reproducible, delivered as a module with tests. Do not choose this when you need a unit outside the declared set, currency conversion, or dimensional analysis over compound units such as kilograms per cubic metre: the template covers the units it names and rejects the rest rather than approximating. Example requests: Write a Python module that converts between metric and imperial units with tests. | I need a unit converter for metres, feet, kilograms and pounds that is exact. | Generate a unit-conversion module covering length, mass and temperature and prove it with pytest. | Convert units and measurements: take a quantity in metres, feet, kilograms or pounds and return it in another named unit, with tests.

module_name.description: Lowercase module name, used for the file name.

template.description: Which registered behaviour to produce. The behaviour is fixed by the template and verified by the template's own tests.
